dripWindow.title: PMKSY Drip & Micro-Irrigation Application Window Open
dripWindow.summary: Eligible farmers in drought-prone talukas can submit pre-filled applications for up to 80% subsidy.
dripWindow.body: Subsidies under PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana are available for certified land parcels. Verification will be auto-completed via Mahabhumi records.

solarDeadline.title: Solar Agriculture Pump Subsidy Deadline Approaching
solarDeadline.summary: Window closes on August 31, 2026 for priority small and marginal farmers.
solarDeadline.body: Ensure your electricity connection NOC and cultivable land records are verified in the profile before final submission.

revisedForm.title: Self-Declaration Format Revised (Version 3.1)
revisedForm.summary: Single-page digital consent and crop confirmation declaration replaces physical affidavit.
revisedForm.body: Physical stamp papers are no longer required for scheme applications under ₹1,00,000 when authenticated digitally.

corrigendumNorms.title: Corrigendum: Landholding Ceilings for Drip Subsidy in Dryland Areas
corrigendumNorms.summary: Maximum ceiling relaxed to 5 hectares for rainfed dryland farmers in Pune division.
corrigendumNorms.body: Amended guidelines apply to all applications submitted after August 15, 2026. Prior applicants need not re-apply.

serviceAdvisory.title: Scheduled Portal Maintenance on August 24
serviceAdvisory.summary: MahaDBT integration gateway will undergo brief maintenance between 22:00 and 04:00 IST.
serviceAdvisory.body: Application submission will pause during the maintenance window. Existing saved drafts will remain securely stored.

archivedKharif.title: Kharif 2025 Certified Seed Subsidy Window Closed
archivedKharif.summary: Application window concluded on July 31, 2025. Benefit disbursals completed.
archivedKharif.body: Archived for transparency and verification audit purposes.
